Chapter 989: Chapter 7: The Structure of the Universe Within (Please Subscribe)

Lin Yuan looked at the gourd in his hand.

At this moment, the gourd was no longer the original gray-purple color.

Instead, it had become a translucent jade color.

Pure.

Flawless.

Lin Yuan gently stroked it, and a mass of information surged from the gourd into his mind.

“This jade gourd…”

A look of astonishment appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The information conveyed by the transformed jade gourd was not difficult to comprehend.

The general idea was—

Since Lin Yuan had awakened the gourd to its current state, he must have already absorbed the previous seven types of Divine Liquid, completing the most basic foundation setting.

To fully refine the jade gourd, one must comprehend the 3,333 symbols contained within the space of the gourd within a Cosmic Era.

Only by doing so could one completely control the jade gourd and obtain the greatest benefits contained within it.

“After absorbing the seven-colored liquids, allowing the inner world to break through its shackles and expand to twenty-three times its original size, is this merely completing the most basic foundation?”

Ripples stirred in Lin Yuan’s heart; until now, even after spending time on the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

He had never heard of any methods that could enhance the fundamental size of the world within a life form, let alone an expansion by twenty-three fold?

“This gourd…”

Lin Yuan steadied his mind. Since he had obtained the gourd, he had made various guesses and speculations, but he had never expected it to be like this.

“3,333 symbols…”

Lin Yuan hesitated for a moment, and then sent a sliver of his Primordial Spirit, attempting to penetrate into the gourd.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan found himself in a vast expanse, where the oppressive feeling of space was terrifying to the extreme. A single strike, which could destroy a galaxy in the universe, could only break a stone here.

“The Space-Time Rule along with many pillar rules, as well as the fundamental structure of this world…” Lin Yuan’s expression was slightly stern.

Just this world alone made him extremely solemn.

“Where are the symbols?”

Lin Yuan looked around. According to the information passed on by the jade gourd, he would enter the world within the gourd, yet he had to comprehend the 3,333 symbols.

At that moment.

The power of the world converged, forming a figure.

This figure stood there quietly, surrounded by dozens and hundreds of faint temporal rivers flowing around.

Perhaps it wasn’t that the temporal rivers were faint, but rather that the figure was too immense, only appearing to be of normal stature in front of Lin Yuan.

His hair was twisted and bent, as if containing endless time and space. Even as a mere projection, it exuded a sense that could collapse everything.

“I’ve lost track of how long I’ve lived, a life of ease and carefree.” The figure spoke indifferently, “Until one day, I suddenly felt that I should leave something behind for this dimension, after all, I was born here. Leaving nothing would be somewhat inappropriate.”

“This dimension…” Lin Yuan was shocked.

An existence described by the term ‘dimension’ must be at an unimaginably high level of life.

The Chaos Void is vast and boundless, and this boundless Chaos Void is just a part of that dimension, perhaps as a main body, but the concept of dimension is definitely greater than that of the Chaos Void.

The many worlds Lin Yuan had traversed in the past all originated from other dimensions.

“After much thought, I crafted thirty-three jade gourds and scattered them everywhere. Those who are fated will obtain them.”

“Each jade gourd contains my Tao, my laws, my foundation, my core…”

“And this jade gourd represents my very foundation.”

“I have always believed the foundation is extremely important. With a solid foundation, even if the Tao practiced or laws cultivated are slightly weaker, it can be compensated for by the foundation. A solid foundation makes everything easier for life.”

The figure said with a faint smile.

“Foundation…” Lin Yuan’s expression turned thoughtful.

Although he did not know what foundation the figure was referring to, it should relate to the inner world or inner universe through the seven kinds of liquids from the mystical gourd previously.

If that was indeed the case, then what this figure said was truly accurate.

Even before stepping into the Second Layer, having an inner world several dozen times larger than other beings of the same level allowed him to sweep through them with ease – so what if his understanding of rules wasn’t as profound as others? With a vast inner world and abundant strength from the world’s power, he could break all laws with force.

Of course, all along, Lin Yuan’s strongest aspect was his rule comprehension; with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, comprehending rules was easier than ever for him.

“Don’t rush. You can only obtain what I have left behind by fully refining the jade gourd.”

“To refine the jade gourd, you must comprehend the 3,333 symbols I have left within one Cosmic Era.”

“If you haven’t comprehended these 3,333 symbols, or if the time taken exceeds one Cosmic Era, it just means you are not suitable for the path of my foundation.”

“At that time, the jade gourd will vanish and randomly appear anywhere in this dimension, awaiting the next fated individual.”

After speaking, the figure smiled faintly.

And with that, he directly dispersed into thousands of symbols, floating within this world.

“The jade gourd will disappear if I can’t comprehend it?” Lin Yuan tensed up, by now he knew that the one who left the jade gourd could very well be the legendary Thirteenth Layer temporal being.

An item left by a temporal being would make a group of Chaos Great Saints envious and even fight to the death over it.

If possible, he certainly didn’t want the jade gourd to disappear.

“With a Cosmic Era as the time limit, the difficulty of comprehending these symbols must be incredibly high,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.
